review_text: The Mahindra Thar engine has massive torque and off-road capability is unbeatable. However, high-speed highway stability requires continuous steering correction.
ADAS features on the XUV700 worked flawlessly during expressway cruising. Cabin space and screen graphics are top notch.
Road presence and suspension comfort are stellar. Only issue is occasional lag in the touchscreen infotainment system.
5-star safety gives immense peace of mind. Fuel efficiency in city mode averages around 14.5 kmpl, which is very reasonable.
The hybrid powertrain is ultra quiet and seamless. Mileage is touching 19 kmpl in city traffic, astonishing for an 8-seater MPV.
Rugged reliability and bulletproof resale value. The ride is on the stiffer side compared to modern monocoque SUVs.
Panoramic sunroof, ventilated seats, and butter smooth IVT automatic transmission. Perfect family urban SUV.
1.5 turbo petrol engine is an absolute rocket. Cabin plastics could feel slightly more premium at this price point.
Dual 10.25-inch screens and 360-degree camera clarity are class leading. Ride quality is much more compliant than earlier generations.
800V ultra-fast charging reaches 80 percent in 18 minutes. Mind-bending acceleration that pins you back in your seat.
Strong hybrid system delivers phenomenal 24 kmpl real world economy. Boot space is somewhat compromised due to the battery pack.
Z-series 3-cylinder engine is very peppy in lower gears and highly economical. Light steering makes parking effortless.
The 1.5 i-VTEC revs eagerly with a melodious exhaust note. Rear legroom and seating ergonomics are the benchmark for C-segment sedans.
Upright SUV stance and great visibility. High RPM engine noise penetrates the cabin during hard overtakes.
German engineering at its best with 5-star Bharat NCAP rating. The steering feedback and cornering grip inspire unmatched confidence.
Crisp handling and punchy 1.0 TSI engine. Brake pads squealed slightly in the first 1000 kilometers but dealer fixed it.
Massive 521-liter boot and high ground clearance tackle rough monsoon roads easily. DSG gearbox shifts lightning fast.
Solid sheet metal and clean interior aesthetics. Wireless Apple CarPlay disconnected twice during long trips.
Lounge-like rear seating and enormous touchscreen display. Fuel economy in stop-and-go metro traffic is heavy on the wallet.
Punchy electric torque with 380 km realistic range. Low running cost per kilometer makes it an economical daily driver.
Blade battery technology gives great thermal safety. Futuristic guitar-string door pockets are quirky and stylish.
530 horsepower dual motor rocket ship that out-accelerates sports cars. Luxury interior trim rivals European luxury marques.
Off-road trailhawk capability is outstanding. However, authorized service center labor charges are noticeably steep.
Exceptional value for money package with wireless charging and turbo CVT. Cabin insulation could have reduced road noise better.
Striking crossover design and generous 405-liter boot space. High-speed engine vibration noticed past 110 kmph.
